title: Russian Doll Envelopes
goal: Solve Russian Doll Envelopes: Sort envelopes by width and descending height for equal widths, then find a strictly increasing height subsequence.
strategy: Sort envelopes by width and descending height for equal widths, then find a strictly increasing height subsequence.
edgeCases: Equal widths cannot nest; descending tie order prevents the height subsequence from selecting them together.
inputRules: envelopes must be an array, e.g. [[2,3],[5,4]]
each envelope must be a [width, height] pair of numbers
